notes: «حدثوه عن أبي هريرة» : Ata, Busr and al-Araj are three co-transmitters of Zayd, so they share one level (rule 2)
«وحدثنا عبد بن حميد» comes after the saying with its own names: a second group, with no shared tail (rule 4)
«بمثل حديث مالك عن زيد بن أسلم» points back to the first group and names no different transmitter, so it is not a variant group
«مالك», «زيد بن أسلم» and «أبي هريرة» each stand twice in the text; the occurrence numbers keep them apart
